2608.28853.title: Equivariant Sheaf Neural Networks: Learning Geometric Transport on Graphs
2608.28853.paper_summary: Equivariant graph neural networks provide a principled way to model geometric systems, but efficient first-order architectures remain limited in how vector information can be transformed as it moves across a graph. We introduce \textsc{ESNN}, an Equivariant Sheaf Neural Network that enriches this interaction by learning directed, matrix-valued transport between neighboring vector features while preserving exact Euclidean equivariance. Rather than increasing the order of the representation, ESNN keeps scalar and vector features first-order and places the additional geometric flexibility in the edge transport itself. We characterize this transport theoretically, showing that when relative displacement is the only covariant geometric input, every linear $O(n)$-equivariant map decomposes into independent radial and tangential components, while learned covariant features enable richer feature-conditioned transformations. We also introduce controlled symmetry relaxation for systems with a preferred ambient direction, which may be prescribed or inferred from data while recovering full $E(n)$-equivariance when the directional pathway is inactive. Across particle dynamics, mesh-based simulation, point-cloud classification, and molecular property prediction, ESNN improves dynamics prediction, recovers the gravity axis when symmetry is broken, yields substantial gains on selected mesh tasks and long-horizon rollouts, and remains robust to unseen rotations. These results show that learning how geometric information is transported across edges offers a complementary route to expressive equivariant message passing without requiring higher-order representations.
2608.28853.paper_summary_zh: 等變圖神經網絡提供了一種有原則的方法來建模幾何系統，但高效的一階架構在向圖中移動時如何轉換向量信息仍然有限。我們介紹了\textsc{ESNN}，一種等變束神經網絡，它通過學習相鄰向量特徵之間的有向矩陣值傳輸來豐富這一互動，同時保持精確的歐幾里得等變性。ESNN並不是增加表示的階數，而是保持標量和向量特徵為一階，並將額外的幾何靈活性放在邊緣傳輸本身。我們從理論上描述了這種傳輸，顯示當相對位移是唯一的協變幾何輸入時，每個線性$O(n)$-等變映射都可以分解為獨立的徑向和切向分量，而學習的協變特徵則使得更豐富的特徵條件變換成為可能。我們還為具有優選環境方向的系統引入了受控對稱放鬆，這可以根據數據進行指定或推斷，並在方向通道不活躍時恢復完整的$E(n)$-等變性。在粒子動力學、基於網格的模擬、點雲分類和分子性質預測中，ESNN改善了動力學預測，當對稱被打破時恢復重力軸，對選定的網格任務和長期展開產生了實質性的增益，並且對未見的旋轉保持穩健。這些結果表明，學習幾何信息如何在邊緣之間傳輸提供了一條補充路徑，以表達等變消息傳遞，而不需要更高階的表示。
